Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MMC.
Our gross margin expanded by 43 basis points to 44.5%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 43 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2019.
Our gross margin expanded by 43 basis points to 44.5%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 12% to 26% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. We generated $13.0 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Revenue guidance of $16.4 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
